1.0.name: Lidar1
1.0.description: Lidar1 is a high-resolution LiDAR sensor designed for capturing detailed 3D point cloud data of the surrounding environment. It is ideal for applications such as autonomous vehicles, robotics, and environmental mapping.

Range.description: The maximum distance (in meters) that the Lidar1 can accurately measure.

NumberOfChannels.description: The number of laser channels in the Lidar1 sensor, determining the vertical resolution of the scanned environment.

PointsPerSecond.description: The total number of points the Lidar1 sensor can capture per second, affecting the density of the point cloud data.

RotationsPerSecond.description: The speed at which the Lidar1 sensor rotates, measured in revolutions per second.

VerticalFOVUpper.description: The upper limit of the vertical field of view (in degrees) for the Lidar1 sensor.

VerticalFOVLower.description: The lower limit of the vertical field of view (in degrees) for the Lidar1 sensor.

HorizontalFOVStart.description: The starting angle of the horizontal field of view (in degrees) for the Lidar1 sensor.

HorizontalFOVEnd.description: The ending angle of the horizontal field of view (in degrees) for the Lidar1 sensor.

1.0.name: DepthCamera1
1.0.description: DepthCamera1 is an advanced depth-sensing camera that captures high-resolution depth images and RGB data simultaneously. It is suitable for applications such as 3D reconstruction, gesture recognition, and augmented reality.

ResolutionWidth.description: The width of the depth image resolution in pixels.

ResolutionHeight.description: The height of the depth image resolution in pixels.

FieldOfView.description: The horizontal field of view (in degrees) of the DepthCamera1 sensor.

MinDepth.description: The minimum depth distance (in meters) that the DepthCamera1 can accurately measure.

MaxDepth.description: The maximum depth distance (in meters) that the DepthCamera1 can accurately measure.
